verdict.rationale: Linear documents its own GraphQL API with personal API keys and OAuth2. That gives non-interactive programmatic access a CI job or script could use to automate Linear without the UI, and an official MCP server also lets agents read and change issues. Nothing in the evidence shows a dedicated headless mode, CLI, or CI integration, so the story is met only through scripting against the API. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, documented CI integration (e.g. GitHub Actions), and CI usage examples or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: The Linear API supports personal API keys and OAuth2 authentication.
It supports introspection so you can query the whole schema.
official MCP server documented at https://linear.app/docs/mcp
